title: [PTRun][Calculator] Persist copied results without a post-write OLE flush

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: A direct-launch discriminator now reproduces a create_directories filename-or-extension-too-long failure for the 263-character output path while retaining the successful control's launcher, working directory, executable and inputs. It exited 1, generated no output and released the exclusive lock. This removes the earlier launcher and working-directory confounder, but does not isolate path length from whitespace or depth, and does not explain the earlier abnormal exit. A source-only final discriminator uses a 133-character output path, with the longest observed generated child path expected at 154 characters; its parent differs, so it is not a same-parent comparison. That discriminator has not run. No upstream PR defect or downstream validation result is established.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
